Support throughout the corporate lifecycle

The Circosta Law Firm provides comprehensive assistance in corporate and business law, supporting companies, start-ups, foundations and investors throughout all stages of the corporate lifecycle. We handle:

  • company formation;
  • governance;
  • shareholders' relations;
  • extraordinary transactions (mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs);
  • corporate restructuring.

Commercial relationships and litigation

We also assist in national and international commercial relationships, drafting contracts, joint ventures and partnerships, and we represent clients in complex corporate litigation.

Thanks to our international presence, we deliver a strategic and integrated approach that combines growth objectives with compliance requirements in multiple jurisdictions.

Our mission

Our mission is to empower businesses with solid legal frameworks, ensuring sustainable growth and competitiveness in global markets.
